task: Draft the Volunteer Engagement section of a fictional community organization's annual report web page. Introduce the accompanying bar chart, describe the quarterly distribution with all four values, note the goal-attainment fact, and provide context about volunteer and project counts. Do not attribute quarterly variation or goal attainment to specific causes not in the facts. Target 300–450 words.

facts.text: The section heading is Volunteer Engagement and it appears in the 2023 Annual Report of Riverside Commons.
Quarterly volunteer hours: Q1 840, Q2 1,120, Q3 1,350, Q4 1,040.
Volunteers completed 88 distinct projects across the four quarters.
The organisation's stated goal for 2023 was 4,000 volunteer hours.
The actual total of 4,350 hours exceeded the goal by 350 hours.
Q3 was the highest quarter; the report does not attribute this to any specific cause.
No comparison to prior years is available in the supplied data.
The bar chart is embedded in the annual report web page, not a printed document.

forbidden_additions: A year-over-year comparison not in the supplied data.
A stated reason for Q3 peak or goal attainment not in the facts.
preserve: 4,350 total hours from 312 volunteers across 88 projects.
Q3 as highest quarter without attributed cause.
Descriptive section that introduces the chart without invented interpretation.
